author: Mihqita98191
quote:
For years the game has been about heist, money, cars, owning empires, drugs... Now I have to bend over for Lucia so she can cheat on me. Women have developed the game... It shows(don't get me wrong there are a lot of good games made by women). Gta was for man by man! Unless you are a glazer you will realize that the plot is gone... "optional" house work, i dont want it to be an option to repair a house for a women... In GTA V, we had strip clubs... You want to fire a rpg inside go for it... Now it is protected????? Some NPC's can't be killed? The arm's dealer in 5 has more deaths then the iq of the entire current Rockstar team.
Can't steal a car in my neighborhood, what the F... When i said this online they said "get a forklift and move the car" ‍♂️ ah yes, my dumbass thought I can steal a car by driving it I forgot I need a forklift... I really hope the Pc and online launch will save the game. I'd hate to see rockstar flop as I've got so many memories running a weed cartel in 5, space laser was really fun... Just disappointing man, I am really sad to see the game in this state. The moment I realised the game is messed up, was when my wife said " where is the action?", she doesn't play games... You realize that a game about guns, hookers, heists, robberies doesn't have action, that's coming from a non gamer... Y'all messed up really bad. But hey, this is my opinion, I refunded the game after a few hours, unfortunately I can't play this.
